natural_language: One Strata row per (study, stratum) combination, with a plain-English Description of what this subgroup represents and why it matters.
adapter_note: Required for interpretability. The DAG computes rates without it, but the explanation of the paradox requires this context.
name: adapter-stratum-seed

natural_language: Four StratumSummaries seed rows per study (one per stratum × treatment combination) — only StratumSummaryId, Study, StratumLabel, TreatmentLabel required; all computed fields are populated by the DAG.
adapter_note: Minimum hydration contract: provide the four raw-key fields. The re-hydrate step fills in all derived values from the views.
name: adapter-stratum-summaries

natural_language: One StratumVariables row per study naming the confounding variable, its CausalRole (confounder/mediator/contested), and a MechanismNote explaining how the allocation imbalance arises.
adapter_note: CausalRole must be one of: confounder, mediator, contested, unknown. IsConfounder is derived (confounder AND both affect-flags true).
name: adapter-stratum-variable

natural_language: The four-type classification: A=full reversal (A wins all strata, B wins pooled); B=partial reversal (split strata, pooled contradicts weighted); C=distortion without reversal (same winner, but margin compressed or inflated by ≥1pp); D=trustworthy pooled (allocation-free or near-free).
adapter_note: Output. Read-only for the researcher.
name: class-distortion-type

natural_language: The recommended analytic action given the distortion type: A→stratify immediately (pooled is misleading); B→investigate the confounder structure; C→report allocation bias alongside pooled result; D→pooled analysis is trustworthy.
adapter_note: Output. This is the instrument's primary policy-facing deliverable.
name: class-policy-implication

natural_language: The fraction of all treatment-A cases that fall in this stratum — treatment A's allocation weight.
adapter_note: Sums to 1.0 across strata within a study.
name: derived-alloc-fraction-a

natural_language: The absolute magnitude of the allocation distortion — how much the observed pooled gap differs from the equal-weight benchmark.
adapter_note: Zero means no allocation confounding. > 0.01 is the classification threshold for types C and D.
name: derived-allocation-distortion

natural_language: TRUE when the pooled winner (SignedPooledGap) points in the opposite direction from the equal-weight per-stratum winner (WeightedStratumGapSum). This is the sign of a reversal.
adapter_note: The primary reversal detector.
name: derived-is-sign-flip

natural_language: The overall (pooled, unstratified) success rate for treatment A across all strata.
adapter_note: Computed from SUMIFS across CaseCells. This is the rate a naive observer would report.
name: derived-pooled-rate-a

natural_language: The overall (pooled, unstratified) success rate for treatment B across all strata.
adapter_note: Computed from SUMIFS across CaseCells.
name: derived-pooled-rate-b

natural_language: The signed difference in pooled rates (A minus B). Positive means A appears better pooled; negative means B appears better.
adapter_note: The naive result — what the unadjusted analysis reports.
name: derived-signed-pooled-gap

natural_language: The signed per-stratum rate difference (A minus B). The true causal signal for this stratum, free of allocation effects.
adapter_note: Computed from within-stratum aggregation of CaseCells.
name: derived-stratum-gap

natural_language: The success rate for this specific treatment within this specific stratum.
adapter_note: Computed automatically. Range [0,1].
name: derived-stratum-rate

natural_language: The stratum gap weighted by the average of A's and B's allocation fractions — the equal-weight contribution of this stratum.
adapter_note: Summing across strata yields WeightedStratumGapSum.
name: derived-weighted-stratum-gap

natural_language: The equal-allocation benchmark: what SignedPooledGap would be if each treatment received the same case-mix. This is the allocation-free signal.
adapter_note: Compare to SignedPooledGap to detect distortion.
name: derived-wgs

natural_language: Total number of observations (trials, patients, applicants, etc.) in this cell.
adapter_note: Must be a positive integer. Every (Study, Stratum, Treatment) combination must have exactly one CaseCell row.
name: input-cases

natural_language: The label of the subgroup (stratum) for this cell — the variable being stratified on (e.g. 'large', 'high-risk', 'male').
adapter_note: Must be consistent across the A and B cells within the same stratum. At least 2 strata required.
name: input-stratum

natural_language: A unique identifier for the study being classified (e.g. 'kidney-1986').
adapter_note: Assign a slug that is stable and unique. All rows for a study share this value.
name: input-study

natural_language: Count of successful outcomes (survived, passed, admitted, etc.) in this cell.
adapter_note: Must be a non-negative integer ≤ Cases. Define 'success' consistently across all cells in the study.
name: input-successes

natural_language: Which treatment (exposure, group, class) this cell belongs to — 'A' or 'B'.
adapter_note: Exactly two treatment labels per study. Encode the group you want to investigate as 'A'; comparator as 'B'.
name: input-treatment

natural_language: Theorem (loop-75, conditional): given correct causal-role annotation, collider/selection studies produce no manifest sign-flips at observed allocation.
adapter_note: Build-breaking invariant inv-collider-no-manifest. Promoted conc-30.
name: theorem-collider-no-manifest

natural_language: Theorem (loop-73): CorrectedGap is invariant under allocation reweighting — conserved quantity across AllocationSweep.
adapter_note: Build-breaking invariant inv-corrected-gap-invariant. Promoted conc-28.
name: theorem-corrected-gap-invariant

natural_language: Theorem (loop-74): IsParadoxExplained ⟺ confounder manifest sign-flip — adjust-resolvable confounding is the unique explanation.
adapter_note: Biconditional: inv-explained-sign-flip-confounder + inv-confounder-signflip-explained. Promoted conc-29.
name: theorem-explained-confounder

natural_language: Theorem (loop-44): manifest sign-flip requires SignalPurity < 0.5 — allocation noise exceeds true signal.
adapter_note: Build-breaking invariant inv-sign-flip-signal-purity-max. Category=theorem in conc-12/20.
name: theorem-signal-purity
